text: 7月15日，中国人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，利率方面，后续人民银行将根据宏观经济运行情况、物价走势和宏观调控的需要，引导调控好利率水平，促进社会综合融资成本低位运行。
text_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that regarding interest rates, the central bank will guide and regulate interest rate levels based on macroeconomic conditions, price trends, and macro-control needs, promoting low comprehensive social financing costs.
